messages.subject: Year-Stratified-Nmixture Model
parts:
Hello unmarked folk,

I’m running a model within a Year-Stratified-N-Mixture-Model framework where I employed ‘pcount’ function of unmarked package.

I describe here the most parsimonious model's structure:

M = 3931 (grid cells 20*20 km)
response {Ci,j,t}: illegal offtake events (spanning over 9 years)

Model:
pcount(formula = ~ue + ug + rs ~ -1 + np + pa + nha + wr + el +
rd + yr, data = umf, mixture = "NB", se = T, control = list(trace = T,
REPORT = 5))

Three explanatory variables as linear effect for parameter ‘p’ :

1. unemployment metric (spanning over 9 years)
2. ranger post (constant)
3. mammals abundance (spanning across 9 years)

As for the abundance parameter ’N’, I regarded linear effects of protected areas categories (np + pa + nha + wr ) and excluded intercept and year effect (spanning over 9 years).

I tried to run goodness-of-fit test bootstrapping for that parsimonious model with nsim=2, 20, and 50 and 99, it works for all these ‘nsim’ choices, but when I ran 100, 200 or 500, I keep receiving the Error message below:

##++++++++GoF++++++++#

fitstats <- function(fm23) {
observed <- getY(fm23@data)
expected <- fitted(fm23)
resids <- residuals(fm23)
sse <- sum(resids^2, na.rm = TRUE)
chisq <- sum((observed - expected)^2 / expected, na.rm=TRUE)
freeTuke <- sum((sqrt(observed) - sqrt(expected))^2, na.rm=TRUE)
out <- c(SSE=sse, Chisq=chisq, freemanTukey=freeTuke)
return(out)
}
system.time(gof.NB <- parboot(fm23, fitstats, nsim =100, report = 1))
print(gof.NB) # 15:26 am 26 May 2020
str(gof.NB) #

#++++++++++++++Error++++++++++#

Error in checkForRemoteErrors(val) :
3 nodes produced errors; first error: object 'yr' not found
In addition: There were 50 or more warnings (use warnings() to see the first 50)
Timing stopped at: 5.753 0.848 17.85

I appreciate if you could kindly provide me some advices to understand and solve this issue?


regards

Mahmood
